name: GlobeProof – 3D Customer & Review Globe for WooCommerce
author: globeproof

sections.description:
Show visitors that people all over the world buy from you and love it.

GlobeProof turns your WooCommerce orders and product reviews into a slowly turning 3D globe. There is nothing to type in by hand: orders in the statuses you choose (processing and completed by default) add to their country, and approved product reviews show up over the reviewer’s country.

What you get, free:

  • A 3D globe with real NASA satellite imagery, soft atmosphere and smooth motion.
  • One golden dot per country that gently pulses. Countries with more reviews get bigger, brighter dots.
  • Glass labels, iOS style, with reviewers shown as first name and last initial (“María G.”) and “+N” on your top 8 countries (5 on phones). Every other dot opens with a tap.
  • A counter such as “Customers from 47 countries”.
  • Built mobile first: a vertical swipe still scrolls the page, a sideways swipe turns the globe, and the globe only loads when it is about to appear on screen.
  • A block for the WordPress editor and a [globeproof] shortcode.
  • A preview with sample customers, visible only to store managers and clearly marked, so you can try the look before you have orders. Visitors always see your real customers.
  • Works with WooCommerce’s new order storage (HPOS) and the classic one.
  • Accessible: a text list of countries for screen readers, keyboard support, and calm motion when the visitor asks for reduced motion.
  • Translated into Spanish.

Privacy first. GlobeProof only shows countries and totals. Reviewers appear as first name and last initial (“María G.”). Full names, emails, cities and addresses are never sent to the page, and the plugin adds no public API endpoint. A suggested paragraph for your privacy policy is added under Settings > Privacy.

Credits

  • 3D globe: globe.gl 2.46.2 by Vasco Asturiano, MIT license, included minified in assets/vendor (source: https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl). The bundle includes three.js (MIT), d3 modules (ISC), h3-js (Apache-2.0) and other MIT/ISC/0BSD/Unlicense modules.
  • Earth imagery and relief: NASA Blue Marble and topography (public domain), resized from the three-globe examples (MIT).
  • Country borders and centers: Natural Earth (public domain) via world-atlas (ISC).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate GlobeProof from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > GlobeProof to pick which orders count, the dot color and where the globe starts facing.
  3. Add the “GlobeProof globe” block to any page, or paste [globeproof].

Shortcode options: [globeproof height="480" counter="no"].
sections.faq:
Where does a customer’s country come from?

From the billing country of their orders. For reviews, from the reviewer’s account, or from their latest order when they reviewed as a guest.

Which orders count?

Processing and completed orders by default. You can add on-hold orders in the settings. Each customer is counted once, by email.

My store is new. Will the globe look empty?

Turn on the sample customers preview in the settings to see how it looks. Only store managers see the samples, with a notice saying they are not real; visitors always see your real customers and the real counter.

Does it slow down my site?

No. GlobeProof adds a small script and stylesheet only to pages that show a globe. The 3D library and the Earth images are downloaded only when the globe is about to scroll into view, and drawing pauses when it scrolls away. The country totals are cached and refreshed when a new order or review arrives.

Does it load anything from other servers?

No. All files, including the 3D library and the Earth images, are included in the plugin.
